title: GigaTIME virtual multiplex immunofluorescence in DLBCL: reproducible pipeline and data
description:
Reproducible notebook, code and per-patient data for applying GigaTIME (H&E to 21-channel virtual multiplex immunofluorescence) to the DLBCL-Morph cohort (209 cases; 170 analysed). Includes the DLBCL-Morph clinical table and GigaTIME-derived feature tables.

Code: MIT. Data in data/: CC BY-NC 4.0 — cite DLBCL-Morph (doi:10.7937/NVA3-N783). Research use only; not for clinical decisions.
